safety_designation: RESEARCH DEMONSTRATION PROTOTYPE — NOT FOR LIFE SAFETY
mathematical_formula: Exact Garwood Poisson 95% Upper Bound: lambda_upper = -ln(0.05) / (T_seconds / 3600)

definition_1_total_recorded_audio.description: Total duration of all 20 sensor recordings without subtracting gunfire or cooldown.
definition_1_total_recorded_audio.methodological_validity: INVALID — Conflates active ballistic impact and refractory periods with false-alert exposure.

definition_2_eligible_background_matchin.description: Total audio excluding ground-truth event matching windows [t - 0.5s, t + 1.5s].
definition_2_eligible_background_matchin.methodological_validity: RECOMMENDED — Accurately isolates non-event audio outside the temporal matching window.

definition_3_nominal_rounded_quiescent_b.description: Nominal 140.0-second quiescent background duration cited in Phase 20 report.
definition_3_nominal_rounded_quiescent_b.methodological_validity: CONSERVATIVE_STANDARD — Exact match for prompt formula: -ln(0.05) / (140 / 3600).

definition_4_eligible_background_cooldow.description: Total audio excluding detector refractory cooldown periods [t - 0.2s, t + 2.0s].
definition_4_eligible_background_cooldow.methodological_validity: STRICT_HARDWARE_LIMIT — Only periods where detector was actually capable of triggering.

comparison_with_phase18_continuous_negat.scientific_conclusion: Category A's 140 seconds of exposure provides an upper bound of ~77 alerts/hour, which is 150x looser than Phase 18's 6.08-hour benchmark (0.49 alerts/hour). Category A cannot assess false alarm rates.
